## What's Changed

### New Features

- **Custom Background**: Set your own wallpaper for the admin interface, with frosted chrome and translucent cards on top; the login card gets its own frosted-glass controls.
- **Command Palette (⌘K)**: The header search is now a full command palette for jumping around the interface.
- **Section Icons in Navigation**: Sidebar and mobile drawer rows now lead with section icons.
- **Readable Plugin Pages**: Third-party plugin pages get a content canvas so text stays readable over a background.
- **Dressed-Up Log Pages**: System and kernel log pages now follow the theme.

### Improvements

- The sidebar and content now slide together as one when collapsing or expanding.
- Unified header icons on a single icon set.
- Lighter theme assets for a faster load.
- The quick-action toolbar now shows exactly the shortcuts you configured, and nothing else.
- Better compatibility with third-party LuCI apps, including CSS patches for luci-app-qmodem contributed by @cjayacopra.
- More consistent rounded corners across components.
- The content width cap now applies only to centred layouts, leaving wide layouts full width.

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed the top bar not repainting immediately when switching light/dark.
- Fixed log pages: select-all no longer spills outside the log, the view follows the tail, dmesg is left unsplit, and copied text is byte-identical to the original.
- Fixed cramped badges on the wireless overview.
- Fixed DiskMan's partition bar overflowing its card on small screens.
- Fixed custom CSS from `menu.d` not being applied.
- Fixed untranslated mode labels in the theme switcher.

### Other Changes

- For remaining changes, see the [full changelog](https://github.com/eamonxg/luci-theme-aurora/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0)
